stats.text:
When you would reduce a creature to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} with a melee attack, you can instead reduce the creature to 1 Hit Point. The creature then has the {ref:condition/unconscious} condition and starts a {ref:glossary/short-rest}.

The creature remains {ref:condition/unconscious} until it regains any Hit Points or until someone uses an action to administer first aid to it, which requires a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check.
